_what_this_is: The transcripts this project publishes that are bound to a tracked fixture, and can therefore be reproduced by running the command the page documents. scripts/verify_transcripts.py runs each command and requires every anchor to appear both on the page and in the real output.
_why: Measured 2026-08-14 against a pristine checkout: nine tracked surfaces published a `Verdict:` line as CLI output while no command emitted `Verdict:` at all, two guides published `Overall score: NN%` from a formatter no CLI path reaches, and several pages wrote a detector priority as `confidence: NN%`, wording the tool no longer emits.
_not_covered: Transcripts that illustrate a hypothetical project (site/guides/article-9-risk-management.html uses /home/dev/myproject, eu-ai-act-healthcare.html uses sample_medical.py, blog-risk-tiers-in-code.html uses hiring.py) cannot be reproduced by running anything, so they are out of scope here BY DESIGN, not by oversight. They are covered instead by tests/test_documented_transcripts.py::test_no_published_surface_shows_a_retired_output_marker, which proves the marker is retired by running the CLI rather than by asserting it.
_anchor_choice: Anchors avoid the `Regula Scan:` header, which prints an absolute path that differs per checkout, and avoid `Model:`, which carries a decision-model date that moves independently. RESOLVED 2026-08-15: the earlier disagreement between [WARN] [ 63] and [INFO] [ 43] on byte-identical input was never non-determinism. `_is_example_file` (scripts/report.py:169) inspects the resolved path's parts for an 'examples' segment, and a match subtracts a flat 20 (scripts/report.py:273). The published tier bands are BLOCK >=80, WARN 50-79, INFO <50, so the same finding scores 63 and prints WARN when the project sits at a path without that segment, and 43 and prints INFO when it sits under examples/. Demonstrated by copying examples/cv-screening-app to a scratch path with an identical SHA-256 and scanning both: the in-repo path returned [INFO] [ 43], the copy returned [WARN] [ 63]. The documented command scans the in-repo path, so 43 is the correct published value and the earlier 63 anchors were recorded against a location the documented command does not use.
